line: Lenovo Yoga Pro 7i Aura Edition Gen 11 (15" Intel, 2026)
config_name: Yoga Pro 7i Aura Edition Gen 11 — Core Ultra 7 356H, RTX 5050 8GB, 32GB LPDDR5X, 1TB SSD, 15" 2.8K OLED touch 120Hz

specs.display_type: OLED touchscreen, 1100 nits peak HDR / 500 nits SDR, 16:10

battery.notes: 84Wh (VERIFIED on lenovo.com/ca PDP). Panther Lake efficiency helps; OLED touch tier.

price.notes: PDP ld+json shows $3,619.99 CAD for the top listed config (VERIFIED, InStock); this Ultra 7/5050/32GB tier estimated ~$2,700 by subtracting Ultra 9/5060/64GB uplifts. Lenovo CA eCoupon caveats apply.

reviews.quote: Centered around a gorgeous 16-inch OLED display, this Yoga laptop provides the performance and build that graphics pros demand.

praises: OLED touchscreen at 1,100-nit HDR peak in a 15-inch chassis — rare combo for pen annotation of photos
84Wh battery matches the bigger Pro 9i despite the smaller body
Panther Lake Ultra 7 runs cool and quiet in day-to-day creator work
RTX 5050 keeps GPU exports out of iGPU territory at a much lower price than the Pro 9i
~1.55 kg — genuinely portable for a dGPU creator laptop
complaints: Smaller 15-inch screen than the Pro 9i for the same money once configured up
Touch OLED is glossy — reflections in bright rooms
Config price jumps fast at Lenovo checkout with Ultra 9/64GB options
Speakers adequate but not class-leading for a creator line

design_philosophy: The Pro 7i slots under the Pro 9i: a 15-inch Aura Edition creator clamshell with Panther Lake + RTX 50-series and a touch OLED, trading panel size and GPU ceiling for portability and price. This mid tier is the volume seller of the line.
rating_notes: No direct pro review found for Gen 11 Pro 7i (no quote invented; sibling anchor = CNET Pro 9i review via NOTES.md). Ratings inferred from Pro 9i anchor: −0.5 screen_size for 15", +0.7 portability, touch → pen_touch 6.5, Panther Lake iGPU/NPU bump keeps ai_ml level. Specs VERIFIED from lenovo.com/ca PDP (CPU/GPU/RAM/storage/battery). PDP image is a marketing jpg from CDN. CNET quote refers to the 16-inch Yoga Pro sibling; this config is the 15-inch Gen 11.
